text: You're looking for a quick and easy recipe that fits your vegan lifestyle and high protein requirements. I think I have just the thing for you. This Ridiculously Easy Mexican Beans recipe is not only ready in under 10 minutes, but it's also packed with 22g of protein per serving, making it a great fit for your health goal. Plus, it's made with canned beans, which are a convenient and affordable source of plant-based protein. Give it a try and see how you like it!
